notes.title: Beta version updated to 1.1.4
notes.notes:
What's New in 1.1.4

- fixes a crash bug during Rowinda's flashback quest
- several enemies artwork was removed by mistake, now they will show up again

notes.title: Seasons of the Wolf version 1.1.2
notes.notes:
When I did the previous 1.1.1 update I forgot to update some libraries to the new Python 3.0 framework resulting in crashes when accessing some vendors. This should now be fixed.
Also I've updated to a new Ren'Py version since previous one had some issues with certain graphic drivers, which could display garbage on screen.
Achievements also should work fine. Thanks

notes.title: Seasons of the Wolf beta version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
What's New in version 1.1.1 (beta branch)

- updated framework to latest Ren'Py version
- fixed a softlock bug: when in Shacklesplit, to progress you need to pay 500 gold to a barkeeper to reveal some information about a new quest. If you don't have 500 gold you need to sell some stuff and/or do some random battles. Now, you also have the option to haggle the price, basically giving all your gold to obtain the information, without extra grinding required!
